title: Oxygen decline and the shoaling hypoxic boundary
query: Using the supplied CMEMS global biogeochemical reanalysis monthly oxygen, nitrate and chlorophyll for 1993-2020 off California and Oregon (30-48 N, 130-116 W), test the following findings of Bograd et al. (2008, Geophysical Research Letters, doi:10.1029/2008GL034185), which used CalCOFI observations for 1984-2006 in the southern California Current System: (1) dissolved oxygen declined throughout the domain, by up to 2.1 umol/kg per year; (2) the largest relative declines occurred below the thermocline (about 21% at 300 m), with significant trends down to 500 m; (3) the hypoxic boundary (about 60 umol/kg) shoaled by up to 90 m. Test the findings for the overlapping years and say whether the trends continued after 2006. Give a verdict for each finding (reproduced, partly reproduced, not reproduced, or not testable with the supplied data) with quantitative evidence, and explain differences from the paper.

paper.title: Oxygen declines and the shoaling of the hypoxic boundary in the California Current
